critical_code_review_comments: wms_opname3.py: input_uom handling in scan() correctly converts to base uom via core.uom before storing counted_qty (INV-UOM-2 preserved); unknown uom raises HTTPException(400) not 500 — verified live. Variance/reconciliation math (counted - expected_snapshot) is unaffected by input_uom since conversion happens before storage. No regression found.

wms_putaway.py place(): input_uom conversion happens before validating qty <= unshelved, which is correct order (compares base-uom qty against base-uom unshelved). Unknown uom returns 400 cleanly — verified live. uom_trace metadata correctly attached to wh_placement_movements audit record.

core/uom.py: SSOT is clean, well-documented with clear INV-UOM-1..6 invariants, has backward-compat fallback (build_from_legacy) for the ~1031 existing materials without explicit `uoms` array — good defensive design, no regression risk found.

wms_receiving.py (pending movements / scan-in / scan-out) also converts input unit via core.uom when unit differs from base and is a known uom on the material (line ~469-484) — consistent with the SSOT pattern used in putaway/opname3. No issues found.

Minor: wms_opname3.approve() has no explicit test-data cleanup path (approved sessions are terminal by design, cannot be cancelled/reversed via API) — acceptable for production but means any accidental approve during testing requires a manual DB-level stock reversal, which this run had to perform (see seed_data_creation note). Consider adding an admin-only 'reverse opname adjustment' endpoint for cases like this, low priority.
